priceSnapshot.note: The line held, and then it broke the other way. Since the midnight snapshot at 64,316.4, BTC has traded up 703.6 points to 65,020, +1.09% in 4 hours 53 minutes, and it did it by running over shorts. OKX filled $1,126,392 of SHORT liquidations and ZERO dollars of long liquidations in a 52-minute window between 10:32Z and 11:24Z - 192 fills, every single one posSide short being bought back, walking the price from 64,730 up to 65,186.7. That is the exact mirror image of what the midnight session documented: a 34.9-to-1 LONG flush at 64,134-64,163 at 05:32Z, then a 100-to-nothing SHORT flush at 65,050-65,190 six hours later. Both sides of the leveraged book were cleared out inside one session. What price cleared on the way up matters more than the squeeze itself. It took the 64,650 add trigger this desk set only four hours ago, it took the 65,030 level that had rejected six times in 102 hours and had been the add trigger for the four sessions before that, and it reclaimed the daily EMA50 at 64,655.02 - the first time price has closed a 1H bar above that line since 03 Aug. Every timeframe is now aligned for the first time in a week: the 15m, 1H, 4H and daily MACD histograms are ALL positive, at +26.48, +73.28, +1.59 and +41.13, and the 4H and daily both crossed up this session from -33.48 and -0.72. Price sits above every 15m, 1H and 4H EMA on the board. Session range since the midnight mark: low 64,264.4, high 65,209.8, a 945.4-point band worth 0.67 of a daily ATR. The caveat is timing, not structure. The US July payrolls report lands at 07:30 COT, twenty-five minutes after this report is stamped, consensus roughly 80-97k after a 44k ADP miss, into a market pricing a September Fed hike. Price has run 703 points into that print with the short fuel above it already spent.

reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE below $64,650. This RETIRES the 64,150 line that has stood for five consecutive sessions, and the reason is that the structure it was defending has been replaced by a better one 500 points higher. 64,650 is three things at once: the daily EMA50 sits at 64,655.02 and was reclaimed on the 09:00Z 1H close for the first time since 03 Aug; it was this desk's own add trigger set at the midnight session and it fired; and it is the open of the 08:00Z 1H bar that started the squeeze. Price is 370 points above it and the 1H ATR(14) is 221.04, so it is 1.7 average hours away - close enough to be tested on a bad payrolls print, far enough that noise will not reach it. A 1H close back below 64,650 would mean the $1.13M short flush was a liquidity event that got retraced, not a trend change, and the burden of proof goes back to the bulls. The warnings between spot and the line, in order: the 15m EMA20 at 64,774.02, the 64,848.3 realized-liquidation shelf where a single 150-contract fill printed, and the 08:00Z 1H open at 64,601.7. 64,150 remains in invalidatesAt as the level that voids the entire reclaim.

addIf.confirmation: A 4H CLOSE above $65,250. The 64,650 trigger this desk set at midnight has already fired and is why the position is ADD rather than HOLD, so the board needs a NEW level and this is the honest one. 65,250 clears the 65,209.8 session high, it clears the 65,186.7 top of the short-liquidation cascade, and it is the price the midnight session identified from the CoinGlass heatmap as the single extreme-intensity band on the map. Above it the realized-liquidation record for the last week is empty until 65,423.7, which is where the 24 Jul spike topped. The reason it needs a 4H CLOSE and not a touch is that the fuel which carried price here is spent: the $1.13M of shorts that got bought back between 65,050 and 65,190 are gone, so a poke above 65,250 on thin follow-through is a different event from a four-hour bar settling there on real demand.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD but everything underneath it moved, and one thing on the board resolved. FIRST, the midnight session's add trigger FIRED. It set 64,650 as a deliberate step down from the 65,030 level that had rejected six times, on the argument that 65,030 had become a target rather than a trigger and waiting for it meant sitting out every repair. Price cleared 64,650 on the 09:00Z 1H close and then took 65,030 as well within the same two hours. That is the first time this desk's own add level has been reached in a week. SECOND, the reduce line moves up 500 points, from 64,150 to 64,650, and this is the biggest single change to the board in five sessions. 64,150 was never broken - it was tested at 64,159.6 overnight and defended - but price is now 870 points above it and the daily EMA50 at 64,655.02 has been reclaimed, so continuing to run a stop 1.3% below spot would be pretending the structure did not change. THIRD, the momentum picture completed. At midnight the 4H was the holdout, its histogram deepening from -17.38 to -33.48, which is exactly why that report was a range call with a tilt and not a bullish call. The 4H histogram is now +1.59 and the daily is +41.13 from -0.72. All four timeframes positive at once has not happened since 30 Jul. FOURTH, the leveraged positioning inverted inside one session: $125,745 of longs carried out at 05:32Z, then $1,126,392 of shorts carried out at 11:23Z with zero longs. Set against all of that, TWO things argue for 6.2 confidence rather than 7-plus. The US July payrolls report is twenty-five minutes away and price has already travelled 703 points into it, which means the easy part of the move is behind us and the print is a genuine two-sided binary. And the macro trend is unchanged: the daily EMA100 at 66,946.69 and EMA200 at 73,147.53 are both still far above spot, so this is a reclaim inside a downtrend, not a new uptrend. Brent is up another 3.40% to 86.04 on Strait of Hormuz tension and the DXY is up 0.31% to 99.984 - neither is a crypto-friendly backdrop.

$256,041 filled in the 65,100-65,149 band. Together with the two bands either side of it, roughly $797,000 of the $1,126,392 total - 70.8% of the whole cascade - printed inside the 140 points between 65,050 and 65,190.

$64,208 filled between 65,000 and 65,049 as the cascade got going. Spot at 65,020 is sitting inside this band, which is the least comfortable place on the map - directly on top of where the move started.

The only meaningful cluster BELOW spot and the nearest real shelf if payrolls disappoints: $124,318 filled between 64,850 and 64,899 at 10:45:22Z, dominated by one 150.06-contract fill at 64,848.3. That was the first leg of the squeeze. A retrace into it would be a normal retest; a 1H close under it puts the 64,650 reduce line directly in play.

Where the cascade began at 10:32:02Z. Only $2,480 filled in the whole 64,700-64,799 stretch, which means there is very little transacted volume between here and the 64,650 reduce line - thin air on the way down as well as on the way up.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP but the honest caveat is that it is weaker than the raw numbers suggest. The mechanical force in this move was 100% one-directional - $1,126,392 of shorts liquidated against ZERO dollars of longs, across 192 consecutive fills, every one of them a short being bought back. Nothing on this tape argues for downside. But realized liquidations are consumed fuel: the shorts that were sitting between 65,050 and 65,190 are gone, so the same band cannot squeeze twice. What is left is a supply shelf where 70.8% of the cascade transacted, 60 to 170 points above spot, and one real demand shelf at 64,848.3 where $124,318 printed. The asymmetry that matters for the next four hours is that there is almost nothing transacted between 64,650 and 64,850 - $2,480 in the entire 100-point stretch below 64,800 - so a payrolls disappointment has thin air to fall through until it reaches the reduce line.

Price is 65,020, the trigger fired, and the retired 65,030 level was taken as well - the single best-calibrated call of the week.
calibration.note: The midnight row backfills to price_next_report 65,020, reduce_fired false and add_fired true. Reduce did not fire: the standing 64,150 line was never approached this session, the lowest print since the midnight mark being 64,264.4 at 07:00Z, 114.4 points clear. Add DID fire: the trigger was a 4H close above 64,650 and while the 08:00Z 4H bar does not settle until 12:00Z, it has traded as high as 65,209.8 and is holding 65,019.9 with two minutes left, 370 points above the level, and the 09:00Z, 10:00Z and 11:00Z 1H bars have all closed above it. acting_helped is TRUE - the midnight session added at 64,316.4 and price is 703.6 points higher. Worth recording honestly for future calibration: the 65,030 add trigger that the midnight session RETIRED as unreachable was reached four hours later. Lowering it to 64,650 was still correct on the evidence available then, but the desk should note that its instinct to abandon a level right before it prints has now happened twice this week.
